newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on thin trade, Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on thin trade, Tokyo.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at midday after the domestic market drifted without buying interest and leads from Thailand and Japan, said traders.
There were no sales or inquiries and holidays in Bangkok and Tokyo led to more uncertainties in pricing, said the traders.
They added that activity was expected to stay thin.
"This is usual for a Monday, but then again the market has been doing so badly, it can't be otherwise," said a trader.
At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted June RSS One buyer at 275.50 cents ($1.10) a kg, down half cent from Friday's close.
June SMR 20 buyer was unchanged at 259.50 cents a kg.
Trading houses offered SMR CV at 332 cents, SMR L at 310, SMR 5 at 269, SMR 10 at 255 and drum latex at 228 cents.
Traders said prices were expected to fall further with the steady supply of latex after recent improvements in the weather.
